wire_ops.value: Filter issues by structured fields (status, assignee). Does not search text; to find issues by topic or keyword, use search_issues.
Full-text search over issue titles and bodies. Use when the user describes issues by topic or keyword. To filter by status or assignee, use list_issues.
One of: open, in_progress, blocked, closed. open: not started. in_progress: someone is actively working on it. blocked: waiting on something. closed: done.
Include full comment threads, roughly 1 to 2K tokens per issue. Defaults to true. Set false when only titles and status are needed.
